request.query: Summing an indexed zero-preserving function over a finitely supported single equals evaluation at that index and coefficient

items.informal_name: Sum of Single-Nonzero Finite Support Function
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {a : α} {b : M}
  {h : α → M → N}, h a 0 = 0 → (Finsupp.single a b).sum h = h a b
items.informal_description:
If $ h(a, 0) = 0 $, then the sum of the finite support function $ f $, defined by $ f(a) = b $ and $ f(x) = 0 $ for $ x 
eq a $, under the mapping $ h $ is equal to $ h(a, b) $.

items.informal_name: Sum over Single Index in Dependent Finite Support Function
items.informal_description: For a dependent finite support function $ f $ that is non-zero only at index $ i $ with value $ b $, and a function $ h $ mapping $ (i, 0) $ to $ 0 $, the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{supp}(f)} h(i, f(i)) $ equals $ h(i, b) $. This holds when $ \gamma $ is an additive commutative monoid and the support of $ f $ is finite.

items.informal_name: Sum of Single Basis Element in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} {R : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {m : M} {r : R}
  {h : M → R → N}, h m 0 = 0 → Finsupp.sum (AddMonoidAlgebra.single m r) h = h m r
items.informal_description: For any additive monoid $M$, semiring $R$, and function $h : M \times R \to N$ satisfying $h(m, 0) = 0$, the finite sum of the basis element $\text{single}_M(m, r)$ under $h$ evaluates to $h(m, r)$. This expresses that summing a formal $R$-linear combination with a single non-zero coefficient $r$ at $m$ reduces to evaluating $h$ at $(m, r)$.

items.informal_name: Sum over Finite Support Function Equals Single Term Under Non-Zero Condition
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {f : α →₀ M} (a : α)
  {g : α → M → N}, (∀ (b : α), f b ≠ 0 → b ≠ a → g b (f b) = 0) → (f a = 0 → g a 0 = 0) → f.sum g = g a (f a)
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ be a type, $M$ and $N$ be types with $M$ having a zero element and $N$ an additive commutative monoid. For a finite support function $f : \alpha \to_0 M$, an element $a \in \alpha$, and a function $g : \alpha \to M \to N$, if (1) $g(b, f(b)) = 0$ for all $b \neq a$ where $f(b) \neq 0$, and (2) $g(a, 0) = 0$ when $f(a) = 0$, then the sum $\sum_{b \in \alpha} g(b, f(b))$ equals $g(a, f(a))$.

items.informal_name: Sum of Single-Indexed Monomial in Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} {R : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {m : M} {r : R}
  {h : M → R → N}, h m 0 = 0 → Finsupp.sum (MonoidAlgebra.single m r) h = h m r
items.informal_description: In a monoid algebra $ R[M] $ over a semiring $ R $ and an additive commutative monoid $ M $, for any monomial $ \text{single}_m(r) $ (which has coefficient $ r $ at $ m \in M $ and zero elsewhere), and for any function $ h : M \to R \to N $ into an additive commutative monoid $ N $ satisfying $ h(m, 0) = 0 $, the sum $ \sum h(m, r) $ over the monomial equals $ h(m, r) $. This follows because all terms in the monomial vanish except at $ m $, and the zero condition ensures no contribution from zero coefficients.

items.informal_name: Sum of Finite Support Function with Indicator Equals Value at Point
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {N : Type u_16} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ N) (a : α),
  (f.sum fun x v => if x = a then v else 0) = f a
items.informal_description: For a finite support function $ f : \alpha \to_0 N $ where $ N $ is an additive commutative monoid, and for any $ a : \alpha $, the sum over $ \alpha $ of $ f(x) $ multiplied by the indicator function $ \mathbf{1}_{\{a\}}(x) $ equals $ f(a) $. Formally, $ \sum_{x : \alpha} \begin{cases} f(x) & x = a \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} = f(a) $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Finite Support Function with Indicator Equals Value at Point
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {N : Type u_16} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ N) (a : α),
  (f.sum fun x v => if a = x then v else 0) = f a
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \alpha \to₀ N $ where $ N $ is an additive commutative monoid, and for any $ a \in \alpha $, the sum $ \sum_{x \in \alpha} f(x) \cdot \mathbf{1}_{x = a} $ equals $ f(a) $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Single Functions Reconstructs Finite Support Function
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α →₀ M), f.sum Finsupp.single = f
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $f : \alpha \to_0 M$ where $M$ is an additive commutative monoid, the sum of the single functions (each non-zero at one index) reconstructs $f$, i.e., $\sum_{a} \text{single}(a, f(a)) = f$.
